How we use your details

Last updated: October 2026

Who we are

Lead Quest is made by Dr. Arowolo Ayoola. It is free and has no adverts.

What stays on this device

Your child's progress, stars, cards, badges and voice messages are saved only on this device. They leave it only if you save a backup file yourself.

What we receive when you register

The player's first name or nickname, age, boy or girl, country, a player number made by the app, and simple progress counts (stories finished, stars and badges). We only receive an email and phone number if the consent box is ticked: a parent or guardian's for players under 16, and your own if you are 18 or over. Players aged 16 or 17 may give their own email, as long as a parent or guardian knows.

Why

To know how many children use Lead Quest and where, to make it better, and, only with your consent, to send you occasional encouragement and news of new books.

Where it is kept

In a private Google Sheet in Dr. Ayoola's Google account. We never sell your details or share them with advertisers.

Children

For players under 16 we ask for a parent's or guardian's email, not the child's, and only with a parent's agreement. Players aged 16 or 17 may use their own email if a parent or guardian knows. Using Lead Quest without giving an email is always fine.

Your choices

Every email has an unsubscribe link. You can remove your details at any time in the Parent corner, under Family registration. You can also reply to any Lead Quest email to ask for a copy of your details or for them to be deleted.

Changes

If this page changes, the date at the top will change too.

Meet the maker

AA

Dr. Arowolo Ayoola

Dr. Arowolo Ayoola is a researcher and a leader. He started a company called Data-Lead Africa, where his team studies what really helps families, schools and hospitals across Africa, and then helps leaders make better choices.


He believes Africa needs brave, honest leaders who keep going when the road is hard. He made Lead Quest so that you can learn from the greatest leadership stories ever written, one brave step at a time.


Who knows? One day, people might tell stories about the way you led.
